headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while inflation and Middle East energy risk keep Stress extreme
body: Friday closed with the Nasdaq 0.96% higher and VIX near 15.6. Brent settled at $104.61 and the U.S. 10-year yield had approached 5%, preserving inflation and geopolitical Stress. With NQ closed for the weekly break, no live continuation, shallow-pullback, or failed-retracement evidence is available.
